channel.title: AI Tools & Models HOT
channel.description: Daily AI model releases and leading agent updates, scored by rules from 19 sources (16 RSS feeds + 3 Hugging Face org pages). Titles, one-line summaries and links only — no full text republished.

item.title: Qwen Code Desktop v0.28.4
item.description: Qwen Code Desktop ships v0.28.4, strengthening end-to-end tests for scheduled loops and state checks in PR verification.

item.title: Release v0.28.4
item.description: Qwen Code ships v0.28.4, a small maintenance release polishing CI and the managed-agent service, including changes to the manual re-review flow — a quick upgrade for everyday users.

item.title: v4.1.27
item.description: Cline ships v4.1.27 with a major model catalog refresh — 94 new providers and new defaults such as Kimi K3.1 Pro — plus LM Studio auth, MCP read-only badges, and fuller file reads.

item.title: SDK v0.2.1
item.description: Cline SDK v0.2.1 stops trimming file-read results to the 8k cap and passes them through at the 50k file-content limit, so models see the full content.

item.title: desktop-v0.0.50
item.description: Cline's desktop app ships maintenance release v0.0.50.

item.title: CLI v3.0.75
item.description: Cline CLI v3.0.75 defaults one-shot runs to yolo mode so unattended runs skip tool approval, while act mode stays on when auto-approve is off.

item.title: How to build a knowledge factory for AI agents
item.description: LangChain shares a setup that keeps an agent's knowledge fresh: agents spot the gaps, and a curator agent fills them in the background.

item.title: Perplexity and Intelligence
item.description: OpenAI explains how perplexity measures model progress and gives developers a shared way to evaluate emerging capabilities.
